svg.title: Share of the US workforce engaged in agriculture, 1880–2025
svg.desc: Scatter plot of the share of the US labor force (1880–1940) and civilian employment (1948–2025) in agriculture, with a fitted logistic trend.

metadata.data-method: weighted least squares on log(share), main series, each decade weighted equally
